heading: Mandatory Senate ethics training for Members and staff

tree.heading: Training program
tree.text: The Select Committee on Ethics shall conduct ongoing ethics training and awareness programs for Members of the Senate and Senate staff.

tree.heading: Requirements
tree.text: The ethics training program conducted by the Select Committee on Ethics shall be completed by—

children.text: new Senators or staff not later than 60 days after commencing service or employment; and
Senators and Senate staff serving or employed on September 14, 2007, not later than 165 days after September 14, 2007.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 72a–1h of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
